$comment: Fields models.dev lacks or gets wrong in a way that is a code matter (#549, app/src/model-prices/README.md): the 1-hour cache write price, a date after which a model is never offered (retiresNotBefore), a block (blocked: true). Per provider id, then model id; every entry states a one-line reason. The app (app/src/model-prices/overrides.ts) reads its identical copy, model-overrides.v1.json next to it, and a test compares the two. Prices are USD per million tokens as decimal strings. Nothing else belongs here without a test case that shows models.dev cannot hold it. Editing it is a normal pull request.
